review_candidates.title: International Finance Director
review_candidates.description: BLACKBULL GROUP INTERNATIONAL FINANCE DIRECTOR Project Finance | International Fundraising | Investment Banking | Institutional Capital | Asset Management Company: BLACKBULL LAW HOUSE & BLACKBULL Chamber of Investment Location: Dubai / Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates Employment Type: Full-Time / Hybrid Position Level: Senior Executive / Director Experience Required: Minimum 12–15 Years Industry: Investment Banking, Project Finance, Fundraising, Corporate Finance & Asset Management Compensation: Executive Salary + Performance Bonus + Fundraising Incentives + Potential Equity Participation Geographical Focus: UAE, GCC, India & International Investment Markets COMPANY DESCRIPTION BLACKBULL LAW HOUSE, a corporate legal and LegalTech organization operating in coordination with BLACKBULL Chamber of Investment, is developing an international business platform integrating corporate legal management, financial technology, investment structuring, project finance, institutional fundraising, and asset-backed business development. BLACKBULL's strategic initiatives include the commercialization of BLACKBULL AI, development of financial technology and banking-channel infrastructure, establishment of professional training institutions, and expansion of asset-backed investment opportunities in India. The organization is seeking to develop strategic relationships with international banks, investment funds, family offices, institutional investors, private equity firms, and corporate financial institutions across the UAE, GCC, Europe, and Asia. We are seeking an exceptionally experienced International Finance Director who can lead international fundraising, arrange project capital, establish institutional financial relationships, and support the financial development of BLACKBULL's Indian and international projects. ROLE DESCRIPTION The International Finance Director will be responsible for leading BLACKBULL's global fundraising strategy, project financing arrangements, institutional investor relations, banking partnerships, and financial structuring activities. This position requires a senior finance professional with substantial experience in arranging institutional capital, managing complex financial transactions, and executing international project-finance mandates. The successful candidate must possess the ability to independently develop funding strategies, identify qualified capital providers, coordinate investment negotiations, and lead transactions from initial engagement through financial closure. This is a results-oriented executive leadership position requiring demonstrated fundraising expertise, strong institutional relationships, and practical transaction-execution capabilities. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. International Fundraising & Capital Arrangement - Develop and execute international fundraising strategies for BLACKBULL projects. - Arrange institutional investment through banks, family offices, private equity firms, investment funds, corporate investors, and private credit providers. - Establish strategic financial relationships across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Qatar, Europe, and other international markets. - Lead equity fundraising, debt financing, structured investment, and strategic capital partnerships. - Prepare and coordinate investment proposals, investor presentations, financial projections, and capital-raising documentation. - Negotiate investment terms and coordinate transaction execution. - Develop sustainable institutional fundraising channels for long-term project financing. 2. Project Finance & Investment Structuring The Director must possess advanced knowledge of project finance and demonstrate the ability to structure funding for new, existing, and pre-revenue projects. Responsibilities include: - Project feasibility analysis and financial modelling. - Debt and equity capital structuring. - Acquisition finance and structured credit. - Asset-backed project financing. - Syndicated financing and institutional lending. - Financial risk assessment and credit evaluation. - Investor-return modelling and exit planning. - Capital allocation and investment monitoring. - Due diligence and transaction management. The Director will evaluate each project's financial viability and determine suitable funding structures based on commercial potential, available assets, projected cash flows, and investor requirements. 3. Banking & Institutional Financial Partnerships Develop strategic alliances with international banking and financial institutions to support BLACKBULL's financial development initiatives. Responsibilities include establishing relationships with commercial banks, investment banks, private credit institutions, asset managers, development finance institutions, and other eligible financial organizations. The Director will also support proposed banking-channel and NBFC development opportunities in India, including capitalization strategies, institutional partnerships, and financial infrastructure planning, subject to regulatory approvals. 4. LegalTech & FinTech Fundraising Lead investment development for BLACKBULL's technology projects, including: - BLACKBULL AI LegalTech research platform. - Corporate legal technology and compliance systems. - FinTech and proposed financial-wallet infrastructure. - Banking-channel and financial-services development. - Professional training and institutional education projects. - Technology commercialization and international expansion. The Director must understand how to present pre-revenue technology projects to sophisticated investors using realistic business models, commercialization plans, financial projections, governance structures, and risk-adjusted investment opportunities. 5. Asset Management & Asset-Backed Investment Support fundraising and investment structuring for eligible Indian assets and businesses, including commercial properties, industrial assets, operating companies, acquisition portfolios, and revenue-generating businesses. The role requires expertise in asset valuation, collateral assessment, loan-to-value ratios, credit enhancement, security structures, asset acquisition, portfolio management, and financial risk mitigation. The Director should be capable of developing institutional investment proposals supported by independently evaluated assets and credible financial assumptions. 6. Cross-Border Investment & Financial Governance - Develop compliant India–UAE investment structures. - Coordinate with legal, tax, banking, and regulatory professionals. - Oversee investment documentation and financial due diligence. - Support investor reporting, transaction transparency, and capital monitoring. - Ensure compliance with applicable AML/KYC, sanctions, foreign-exchange, and investment regulations. - Evaluate international holding, investment, and project-financing structures where commercially appropriate and legally permissible. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS Minimum 12–15 years of relevant experience, preferably including senior leadership responsibilities in international finance, project finance, investment banking, institutional fundraising, or structured finance. Candidates must demonstrate: 1. A proven record of arranging or closing substantial project-finance and fundraising transactions. 2. Strong relationships with international investors, banks, family offices, and institutional capital providers. 3. Advanced knowledge of debt financing, equity investment, bank credit, and financial structuring. 4. Experience managing complex cross-border investment transactions. 5. Expertise in financial modelling, valuation, project feasibility, and investment risk. 6. Strong negotiation, communication, and executive leadership capabilities. 7. Understanding of UAE/GCC investment markets and Indian business financing opportunities. 8. Ability to manage investment discussions, due diligence, documentation, and financial closure. 9. Experience financing early-stage, pre-revenue, or asset-backed projects. 10. High standards of professional integrity, confidentiality, and financial governance. Preferred Qualifications: MBA Finance, CFA, CA, ACCA, Master's in Finance, Banking, Economics, or equivalent professional qualifications. SPECIAL APPOINTMENT CONDITIONS BLACKBULL is specifically seeking an executive who can arrange capital and execute fundraising transactions, rather than someone limited to providing financial recommendations or investor introductions. Shortlisted candidates will be expected to provide a professional summary of: - Major fundraising transactions completed during their career. - Approximate capital arranged or transactions successfully closed. - Current institutional investor and banking relationships. - Experience in project finance and asset-backed investment. - Ability to raise funds for Indian projects through UAE and international channels. - Proposed fundraising strategy for BLACKBULL's LegalTech, FinTech, and asset-development initiatives. - Realistic execution timelines and expected professional contribution. All claims of previous fundraising experience may be subject to reasonable verification and confidentiality restrictions. COMPENSATION & EXECUTIVE BENEFITS BLACKBULL may offer a competitive executive compensation structure consisting of: Fixed Executive Salary + Performance Bonuses + Successful Fundraising Incentives + Potential Equity Participation Additional benefits may include international business travel, institutional networking opportunities, long-term leadership responsibilities, and participation in the development of new financial and investment platforms. Compensation and equity arrangements will be determined through mutual agreement, documented contractual terms, defined performance responsibilities, and applicable regulatory requirements. PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS The International Finance Director will be expected to develop an actionable capital-raising strategy, establish credible institutional relationships, manage a qualified investor pipeline, and progress eligible investment opportunities toward financial closure. Performance will be assessed through measurable outcomes, including investor engagement, transaction readiness, quality of financial structuring, successful institutional partnerships, funding commitments, and completed transactions. Fundraising outcomes will remain subject to investor acceptance, due diligence, market conditions, regulatory compliance, and financial viability. WHY JOIN BLACKBULL? This opportunity provides an experienced international finance professional with the potential to participate in developing an integrated LegalTech, FinTech, project-finance, and investment-management ecosystem. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to shape BLACKBULL's international financial strategy, build institutional capital relationships, and support the commercialization of technology and asset-backed projects in India. We are looking for an International Finance Director who understands how to identify capital, structure investment, negotiate with institutions, and successfully execute complex financial transactions. Candidates with strong fundraising capabilities, genuine institutional relationships, and demonstrated project-finance experience are encouraged to apply. Project Information: www.theblackbullproject.online BLACKBULL LAW HOUSE BLACKBULL Chamber of Investment All regulated fundraising, investment, banking, asset-management, and cross-border financial activities will be undertaken subject to applicable licensing, due diligence, and regulatory requirements.

review_candidates.description: Job Description Title: I.T. Application Support Analyst- Husky (India) Chennai Id: 21360 Type: FullTime Location: Chennai, India At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible. Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team! Job Description The IT Application Support Analyst role is responsible for the end-to-end investigation and resolution of ERP incidents requiring deeper functional or technical expertise, including root-cause analysis, integration troubleshooting, solution validation, documentation, and effective escalation to Level 3 when required. Key Responsibilities/Areas Of Accountability Incident investigation and resolution Analyze ERP incidents escalated from Level 1. Identify root causes and provide functional or technical solutions/workarounds. Reproduce issues and distinguish between configuration, master data, integration, application, and infrastructure problems. Functional support Provide expertise across assigned ERP modules and business processes. Troubleshoot transactional errors and incorrect system behavior. Assist users with complex process or application-related questions. Integration troubleshooting Investigate failures between the ERP and connected applications. Analyze interfaces, error messages, batch jobs, queues, and data flows. Coordinate resolution with other application/support teams when the problem crosses system boundaries. Escalation to Level 3 Determine when an issue requires development, product expertise, infrastructure changes, or vendor intervention. Provide Level 3 with a complete analysis, including reproduction steps, logs, examples, expected versus actual results, and business impact. Validate the solution after Level 3 implementation. Problem management and root-cause analysis Identify recurring incidents and underlying systemic problems. Lead or contribute to root-cause analysis. Recommend permanent corrective and preventive actions. Change and release support Assess the impact of fixes, configuration changes, and ERP updates. Perform functional/system testing and coordinate business validation when appropriate. Support deployments and post-deployment verification. Monitoring and operational support Monitor critical ERP processes, scheduled jobs, integrations, and interfaces. Investigate failures proactively where monitoring is available. Ensure critical business processes are restored within agreed service levels. Ticket and SLA management Own assigned incidents through resolution rather than simply forwarding them. Prioritize according to severity and business impact. Maintain clear, accurate ticket documentation and regular communication with users. Knowledge management Document solutions, known errors, troubleshooting procedures, and recurring issues. Create knowledge articles that enable Level 1 to resolve more incidents independently. Share knowledge with other ERP support team members. Business and IT coordination Act as a bridge between business users and technical teams. Translate business symptoms into technical/functional requirements for specialists. Communicate technical findings in language understandable to business stakeholders. CRITICAL CAPABILITIES Excellent written and verbal communication skills. ERP Functional Expertise Strong understanding of core ERP processes and assigned functional areas (BaanIV, Infor LN, or Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012). Ability to understand how transactions flow across modules. Ability to distinguish process, configuration, master-data, and system issues. Advanced Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis Systematic investigation of complex incidents. Identify symptom vs. root cause. Analyze application errors, logs, jobs, interfaces, and transaction history. Develop and validate workarounds when immediate resolution is unavailable. Integration & End-to-End Process Understanding Understand ERP interfaces with upstream and downstream applications. Trace transactions across systems. Determine where a failure occurred and which team/application owns it. Understand dependencies between ERP, middleware, databases, reporting, and external systems. Incident Ownership & Prioritization Take ownership from escalation through resolution. Assess business impact, urgency, and priority. Drive resolution across multiple technical or functional teams. Maintain clear communication with impacted users and stakeholders. Technical Analysis Ability to investigate application logs, batch processes, queues, interfaces, and error messages. Basic understanding of databases and data structures. Ability to perform data analysis and queries where appropriate. Understand enough of the ERP technical architecture to engage effectively with developers and infrastructure teams. Requirements EDUCATION: Bachelor's Degree/College Diploma in a technical discipline (Engineering or IT related) EXPERIENCE: 3+ years of experience as an ERP application support or ERP analyst preferred. 3+ years of process improvement, data, or technology project experience would be a strong asset. 2+ years of experience working with BaanIV, Infor LN or Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012. review_candidates.title: Human Resources Director
review_candidates.description: Director of Human Resources Location: San Jose, CA or Carson City, NV Reports To: Executive Leadership Employment Type: Full-Time, Exempt Position Overview Rocket is seeking an experienced, hands-on Director of Human Resources to lead and modernize the HR function across our growing organization. This is an opportunity for a strong HR leader to assess the current organization, establish clear ownership and accountability, strengthen processes and controls, and build an HR function capable of supporting a fast-paced, rapidly growing manufacturing business. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable developing HR strategy and rolling up their sleeves to execute. This individual must have the judgment and confidence to challenge existing practices, address organizational inefficiencies, and drive meaningful change while building strong relationships with executives, managers, and employees. Manufacturing experience and demonstrated success leading HR transformation or organizational change are strongly preferred. Key Responsibilities Provide leadership and strategic direction for the Human Resources function across multiple locations. Assess the existing HR organization, processes, and responsibilities and implement changes needed to improve effectiveness, accountability, and service to the business. Establish clear roles and responsibilities within HR and eliminate unnecessary duplication or inefficiencies. Develop and implement scalable HR policies, procedures, systems, and controls to support continued company growth. Partner with executive leadership on organizational structure, workforce planning, succession planning, talent strategy, and other people-related initiatives. Establish consistent job architecture, job descriptions, leveling, compensation ranges, promotion practices, and compensation controls across the organization. Ensure compensation decisions are competitive, internally equitable, and aligned with business needs. Strengthen performance management processes and establish clear expectations and accountability for managers and employees. Coach leaders and managers on employee relations, performance issues, organizational effectiveness, and leadership practices. Provide oversight and guidance on complex employee relations matters, investigations, corrective actions, and terminations. Ensure compliance with applicable federal, California, Nevada, and local employment laws and regulations. Oversee HR programs including onboarding, benefits, employee relations, performance management, training and development, compensation, and HRIS administration. Develop meaningful HR metrics and reporting to identify trends, risks, and opportunities and support executive decision-making. Evaluate HR technology and processes and identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and improved data integrity. Build, develop, and lead a high-performing HR team capable of effectively supporting a growing multi-site organization. Partner closely with Talent Acquisition and operational leadership to ensure workforce needs are anticipated and positions are appropriately structured, leveled, and compensated. Support organizational changes, facility expansions, integrations, restructuring, and other strategic initiatives as required. Foster a culture of accountability, consistency, responsiveness, and continuous improvement. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or related field required; advanced degree preferred. 10+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, including significant HR leadership responsibility. 5+ years of experience leading HR teams and/or a substantial HR function. Experience supporting manufacturing, electronics, semiconductor, aerospace, medical device, automotive, or another complex operational environment strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience improving, restructuring, or modernizing an HR organization or function. Experience supporting both hourly manufacturing populations and professional/executive employees. Strong knowledge of compensation, organizational design, performance management, employee relations, and employment compliance. Experience supporting multiple locations and rapidly growing organizations preferred. Strong working knowledge of California employment law strongly preferred; experience with Nevada employment practices is a plus. Experience developing job architecture, compensation structures, policies, procedures, and HR controls. Strong analytical skills with the ability to use HR data and metrics to drive decisions. SHRM-SCP, SPHR, or comparable professional certification preferred. Leadership Profile The successful candidate will be a confident, pragmatic HR leader who combines strong business judgment with the ability to execute. We are looking for someone who: Is comfortable challenging the status quo and driving change. Can quickly identify what is working, what is not, and what needs to change. Makes decisions and drives implementation rather than allowing issues to remain unresolved. Establishes clear accountability and holds people to appropriate standards. Can operate effectively in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment without excessive bureaucracy. Understands manufacturing operations and recognizes that HR must support the business rather than operate separately from it. Builds credibility with senior leadership while remaining accessible and responsive to employees. Balances strategic thinking with a willingness to personally handle important issues. Communicates directly, professionally, and effectively at all levels of the organization. Compensation The anticipated salary range for this position is: $165,000 – $230,000 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, location, and overall fit for the role.

review_candidates.description: Job Location: Royal Livingstone Resort By Anantara Anantara Hotels & Resorts is a global luxury hotel and resort brand rooted in Thai culture, with an intrinsic sense of authentic hospitality. Inspired by the Sanskrit word meaning ‘without end’, our spirit embodies freedom, movement, and harmony. We believe every journey should leave a lasting impression — for our guests and for our people. Founded in 2001 in Thailand, we have since expanded across the world, welcoming guests in some of the world’s most captivating locales — from pristine beaches and private islands to ancient sites and vibrant metropolises. If you are driven by a passion for generosity, warmth and heartfelt hospitality, Anantara offers a career without limits. Key Duties And Responsibilities Please note that this is not an exhaustive list of everything that needs to be done. AROY employees always find new ways to look after the business, their guests, and their colleagues. Within this, the key responsibilities for this position are:  Ensure that all Guest Rooms are properly cleaned at all times, in line with the hotel’s Standard Operating Procedures for cleaning these areas.  Ensure health & safety requirements are adhered to, including a personal knowledge of the correct usage of all chemicals used in Housekeeping.  Ensure records are maintained for linen inventory, uniforms, and other items as applicable.  Ensure that lost and found articles are processed properly and that the correct logs are maintained.  Ensure that par levels of linen, towels and uniforms are current, and in line with inventory.  Follow and recommend measures to minimize all wastage of materials and amenities are used in the department.  Ensuring security awareness throughout the Hotel, reporting incidents to the appropriate Manager when warranted.  Ensure VIP requirements are met  Ensure all special requests are met, with particular reference to families visiting our resorts with children.  Ensures any special requests from guests are carried out and delivered on time exceeding guest’s expectations where possible.  Clean and take care of all working equipment used by himself / herself.  Report any damage or loss in a guest room immediately after being found.  Remove room service trays from room & place in service area.  Make room status reports.  Report any suspicious person, sleep outs, ‘Do Not Disturbs’ to housekeeping management Not the right fit?
